svg.title: The Draco Occursum - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 90-91, PDF 91-92. Combined envelope follows larger lower deck: stepped forward sensor prow, tapered body and very broad aft aerofoils with separated drive legs/open stern recesses. Upper tank/accommodation deck aligns behind sensor prow at matching grid scale and is contained. Illustration corroborates broad podded stern; vertical tail surfaces and detached turret keys excluded.
